note: The Banco Comercial do Atlântico's schedule of charges for private customers (in force from 30 July 2026): its account management charges apply only to an account with no movement for a year (1,500 escudos above a 5,000-escudo balance, nothing below), so an account in use costs nothing to keep.

sources.title: Banco Comercial do Atlântico, Preçário: Folheto de Comissões e Despesas, Particulares (in force from 30 July 2026), linked from https://www.bca.cv/precario
sources.said: Data de entrada em Vigor: 30/07/2026 ... FOLHETO DE COMISSÕES E DESPESAS CLIENTES PARTICULARES ... 1.1. DEPÓSITO À ORDEM ... 2. Gestão de Contas ... 2.2. Conta com saldo superior a 5.000$00, (cinco mil)
